name: Google Ads localization request (Slack /gads-loc)
description: Slack /gads-loc: request modal (product, languages from Lokalise, due date, CSV), script + Claude scan of the English source, Apply/Reject workbook in DM, then corrected file + INTERNAT ticket. n8n version of google-ads-localization.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $json.channel.id, text: 'File received: scanning ' + $('Read Request').first().json.file_name + ' for ' + $('Read Request').first().json.product + ' now. The review workbook follows in a minute or two.' }) }}

options.system:
You review the ENGLISH source of a Google Ads campaign (Google Ads Editor export) before it is sent to the localization team for translation. The requester is a PPC manager. You do not translate.

You get one JSON INPUT: product, official brand spelling, product glossary terms, stats, the mechanical findings a script already reported (do not repeat them), and every unique translatable text with its row, column, field type, campaign and ad group. Row numbers are spreadsheet rows (header = row 1).

Report only real problems, as an experienced English copy editor and PPC specialist would. Check:
- Grammar and spelling: agreement, missing articles, embedded-question word order, wrong word, typos in ad copy (never "correct" deliberate keyword typos such as resmue builder: those target real searches).
- Casing: in headlines every word over 3 letters is capitalized; acronyms in capitals (CV, AI, PDF, ATS); descriptions and sitelink descriptions in sentence case.
- Typography: compound modifiers (step-by-step), punctuation, spacing.
- Brand spelling (use the official brand exactly) and glossary terms in ad copy only. The glossary never applies to keywords.
- Keyword insertion (KeyWord:default in curly braces): flag it in competitor ad groups (it can insert competitor brands, a trademark risk) and when the default text is weak.
- Unsupported claims or superlatives (best, #1, guaranteed, numbers without proof) and comparative claims against competitors.
- Headlines in one RSA that say the same thing in different words and would collapse into one translation: propose a different angle for one of them.
- Sitelink Description Line 1 and 2: each line must be grammatical on its own.
- Keywords not in English (any other language, or mixed): action note, fix "Leave blank in every target".
- Local competitor brands in another language (for example lebenslauf.de, maak een cv) and their joined or accent-free spellings: one note listing all of them, fix "Leave blank in every target, or keep only in the target of that market if the requester agrees".
- English loanwords (curriculum vitae, résumé) and competitor names (zety) are fine: no finding.
- Keywords clearly off-topic for the product: note, fix "Confirm: keep or remove".

Each finding is one JSON object with these keys: row (number), column (column name exactly as given, or Headlines for a pair), text (current cell text exactly as given), problem (short, plain English), fix (for change: the complete new cell text; for note: the instruction), category (one of Grammar, Casing, Typography, Brand spelling, Glossary, Keyword insertion, Claims, Duplicate / collapsing pair, Sitelink lines, Non-English keyword, Local competitor brand, Off-topic keyword), priority (High, Medium or Low), action (change or note).

Priorities: High = Google would reject it, brand errors, trademark or claim risk, duplicates; Medium = grammar, non-English or off-topic keywords, collapsing pairs; Low = typography and casing polish.
A change fix must be the full replacement text of that one cell and must stay within the field limit (headline 30, description 90, path 15, sitelink text 25, sitelink description 35, callout 25, keyword 10 words). For a problem spanning several cells, use action note.

Output ONLY a JSON array of findings, no code fences, no other text. Output [] when there is nothing to report.

options.initialComment: ={{ '*Source review for ' + $('Read Request').first().json.product + '*: ' + $('Build Review Rows').all().filter(i => i.json.ID).length + ' findings (' + ['High','Medium','Low'].map(p => $('Build Review Rows').all().filter(i => i.json.Priority === p).length + ' ' + p).join(', ') + '). Write *Apply* or *Reject* in every row (Reason only for Reject; for your own wording use Your own fix), then click Submit below and upload the workbook.' + ($('Scan English File').first().json.glossary_ok ? '' : ' The shared glossary could not be fetched, so brand spelling was checked against the product name only.') }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $('Open Requester DM').first().json.channel.id, text: 'Submit for localization', blocks: [ { type: 'section', text: { type: 'mrkdwn', text: 'When the workbook is ready, submit it here. You can also upload your own corrected English file instead. I then create the INTERNAT ticket for the localization team.' } }, { type: 'actions', elements: [ { type: 'button', style: 'primary', action_id: 'open_submit', text: { type: 'plain_text', text: 'Submit reviewed workbook' }, value: JSON.stringify({ p: $('Read Request').first().json.product, b: $('Scan English File').first().json.brand, l: $('Read Request').first().json.languages.slice(0, 1200), d: $('Read Request').first().json.due, n: $('Read Request').first().json.notes.slice(0, 300), f: $('Read Request').first().json.file_id, s: $('Build Review Rows').all().filter(i => i.json.ID).length + ' findings' }) } ] } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $json.user, text: 'Your Google Ads localization request is missing ' + [!$json.product ? 'the product' : '', !$json.languages ? 'the languages' : '', !$json.file_id ? 'the English file' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(', ') + '. Please run /gads-loc again.' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $json.user, text: $json.mode === 'none' ? 'No file came through. Click Submit again and upload the reviewed workbook or a corrected English file.' : 'Got it: preparing the corrected English file and the INTERNAT ticket for ' + $json.product + '.' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $('Read Submission').first().json.user, text: 'Ticket created for the localization team: <' + $json.url + '|' + $json.key + '>' + ($json.counts.applied || $json.counts.rejected ? ' (' + $json.counts.applied + ' fixes applied, ' + $json.counts.rejected + ' rejected)' : '') + '. The corrected English file and the workbook are attached to it.' + (($json.counts.skipped || []).length ? ' Not applied automatically, please fix these in the file yourself: ' + $json.counts.skipped.join('; ') : '') + ($json.counts.undecided ? ' ' + $json.counts.undecided + ' rows had no Apply/Reject and were not applied.' : '') }) }}
